title: Vacuum Myofascial Therapy Device in Treatment of Muscle Fibrosis
brief_summary: We present the case of a 24-year-old professional soccer player, with no personal history of interest, who came to the X-Ray diagnosis service due to severe pain in the right quadriceps muscle after a 10-month evolution of muscle rupture occurred during sports practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria.

* 24-year-old professional soccer player.
* No personal medical history of interest
